column3: On June the second, twenty twenty-two, one of its light sensors simply stopped.
OPS-SAT, the European Space Agency's flying laboratory, re-entered the atmosphere in May twenty twenty-four.
Two open models read what it left behind. Neither may guess.
This is the real console, running on the archive.
We hide the answer, let the model decide, then check it.
And when it misses, we show that too.
Every segment, ranked. Where the archive is silent, so is the card.
Ask the archive anything, and it tells you what it doesn't know.
On the official test split, it beats the best published model, even on the paper's own features.
Eighty-three cents of Tinker: sixty-five to ninety-three percent. One task got worse. We kept it.
Measured, cited, or unknown. Nothing else.
Its mission ended. Its memories did not.
